notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.4
notes.content:
Fixed Unstuck Button UI not getting removed
Fixed Blackjack issues
Fixed Spelling and Grammar mistakes
Fixed Questpage map showing wrong location

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.3
notes.content:
Fixed bug making you get stuck outside of Heart area
Fixed bug with quick move happening without holding shift
Fixed bug with Pause menu being empty
Resized some text to make it more readable on Steam Deck

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.2
notes.content:
Fixed some places where you could get stuck by dashing
Fixed being able to get bloodbeets in Cattle Canyon after Buck's Quest
Fixed water in Oil Spill Hollow
Blackjack Draws now return your bet
Resized text to make easier to read on Steam Deck
Made default resolution on Steam Deck 1280x800

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.1
notes.content:
Added an "unstuck" button
Added instructions for pool
Added default menu shortcuts on controller
Added music to the selling boxes
Fixed being able to get stuck in sliding blocks
Fixed collision at some places that made it possible to get stuck
Fixed issue not being able to sprint when rebinding
Fixed issue with the wrong prompt showing when rebinding
Fixed issue with main menu quit button not working
Fixed issue with not being able to get through breakdown
Fixed issue with being able to reopen a bridge
Fixed issue with player and pet spawning in water
Fixed so item sources reroll the item effect when buying an item effect
Fixed Apply Settings Button on controller
Made Fishing line a bit easier to see
Made controller layout more generic
Always show compiling shaders visual
Rebalanced some items prices
Updated music
